idea-plugin.name: Agent Office — Who's working?
idea-plugin.description:
A tiny pixel-art office inside your JetBrains IDE that shows which of your Claude Code custom agents is working right now.

When an agent starts working, its character walks to its desk. When an agent delegates, the others gather in a meeting room. When a job is done, the result is brought back to whoever asked for it. And when there is nothing to do, everyone heads to the pond or the hammock.

  • Live status: working, idle or unknown, refreshed every 2 seconds, with a status bar summary.
  • Real delegations: visits, meetings and hand-ins follow what your agents actually do.
  • Zero setup: agents, desks and colors are detected from ~/.claude/agents and .claude/agents.
  • Private by design: 100% local and read-only. No code, prompt or conversation is ever displayed.

Open it from View | Tool Windows | Agent Office, or click the status bar item. Settings live under Tools | Agent Office.
idea-plugin.change-notes: • 1.0.0 — first IntelliJ Platform release, ported from the VS Code extension.
